headers = {}

stock_col = headers.get("stock")
cum_col = headers.get("cumulative units")
prev_col = headers.get("previous units", min_col)

if prev_col != min_col:

last_cum_by_stock = {}

    action = orig_ws.cell(r, type_col).value if type_col else None
    units = orig_ws.cell(r, units_col).value if units_col else 0

    action_txt = str(action).strip().lower() if action is not None else ""
    if action_txt == "buy":
